# Forbes

> Forbes is a leading business and lifestyle publication covering breaking news, investing, technology, politics, and entertainment with daily coverage of billionaires, startups, and market trends.

Forbes provides comprehensive coverage of business, finance, technology, and political news with interactive games and puzzles. The site serves as a primary source for breaking news, daily news roundups, and in-depth analysis of trending stories across multiple industries.

## Key Topics

- Business News
- Breaking News
- Technology
- Investing
- Startups
- Fintech
- AI
- Geopolitics
- Politics
- Sports Money
- Billionaires
- Daily News Roundup
- Trending Stories
- Word Games
- Puzzles

## News & Breaking Coverage

- [Forbes Homepage](https://www.forbes.com): Forbes homepage featuring business, investing, technology, and lifestyle news.
- [Breaking News](https://www.forbes.com/news): Latest breaking news stories from Forbes covering business, pharma, and geopolitics.
- [Forbes Daily Cover Stories](https://www.forbes.com/daily-cover-stories): Daily cover stories on billionaires, startups, fintech, AI, and business news.

## Politics & Current Events

- [Trump Tracker](https://www.forbes.com/trump): Trump Tracker: Daily coverage of Donald Trump news and political developments.

## Games & Puzzles

- [Free Online Games - Word Games, Puzzles, & More](https://www.forbes.com/games): Free online games collection including crosswords, word games, and puzzles.
